qera.fit: randomized SVD of stacked E X.T; pseudoinverse lift and QR; LS on X U
qera.correction_dtype: FP32 factors, BF16 residual tiles, BF16 projection output
qera.tile_ranking: calibration output energy of each 16x16 tile of E (I - U U.T)
qera.kl_definition: KL(BF16 || candidate), natural logs, full vocabulary, FP64
qera.quantisation_scope: only gate_proj and up_proj in every layer

pair_benchmark.timed_scope: batch-1 gate/up pair including shared correction; excludes flush
pair_benchmark.flush_caveat: GPU copy-sized memory sweep; physical SLC evictions were not counted

context.query_scope: one terminal causal query per query head, including the final key

kv.dense_reference: chronological dense FP64 attention, directly rounded to BF16 RNE
kv.independent_reference: dense FP64 attention using NumPy exp
kv.rounding_certificate: sphere upper mass; outward intervals cover real attention and dense FP64
kv.clustering: Lloyd Euclidean k-means with capacity-balanced final pages per KV head
kv.rht: signed Hadamard coordinates for grouping only; attention uses original RoPE keys
